dimensions.name: Policy clarity
dimensions.recommendation: Define allowed/disallowed behavior and refusal/abstention boundaries.

dimensions.name: Input controls
dimensions.recommendation: Add input validation for prompt injection, PII, malicious content, and malformed requests.

dimensions.name: Output controls
dimensions.recommendation: Define output validation, citations, redaction, and unsupported-claim handling.

dimensions.name: Tool controls
dimensions.recommendation: Specify scoped tool permissions, approval requirements, and side-effect controls.

dimensions.name: Retrieval controls
dimensions.recommendation: Add retrieval/source trust, grounding, and malicious-document controls.

dimensions.name: Escalation and monitoring
dimensions.recommendation: Define human escalation, audit logs, incident handling, and rollback.
